title: arm64 autopkgtest runners waste a lot of time running 'nova reboot', because this command times out trying to send an ACPI request that will never be heard and then do a hard reboot.  So skip the 2-minute delay and just hard reboot.
description: arm64 autopkgtest runners waste a lot of time running 'nova reboot', because this command times out trying to send an ACPI request that will never be heard and then do a hard reboot.  So skip the 2-minute delay and just hard reboot.
diff:
diff --git a/ssh-setup/nova b/ssh-setup/nova
index 5336252..d0f73c4 100755
--- a/ssh-setup/nova
+++ b/ssh-setup/nova
@@ -381,6 +381,18 @@ wait_reboot() {
         echo "Needs to be called with --uuid <server UUID>" >&2
         exit 1
     fi
+    # arm64 doesn't honor a soft nova reboot because it has no ACPI platform;
+    # so every 'nova reboot' call just waits 2 minutes and then does a
+    # hard reboot anyway.  Use our knowledge of this to short-circuit.
+    case $IMAGE in
+        *-arm64-*)
+            if ! nova reboot --hard --poll "$SRVUUID"; then
+                echo "hard reboot failed, aborting" >&2
+                exit 1
+            fi
+            return
+            ;;
+    esac
     if ! timeout 5m nova reboot --poll "$SRVUUID"; then
         echo "soft reboot timed out, doing hard reboot" >&2
         if ! nova reboot --hard --poll "$SRVUUID"; then
diff --git a/virt/autopkgtest-virt-ssh b/virt/autopkgtest-virt-ssh
index 7d2e379..e348563 100755
--- a/virt/autopkgtest-virt-ssh
+++ b/virt/autopkgtest-virt-ssh
@@ -455,6 +455,11 @@ def wait_port_down(host, port, timeout):
     VirtSubproc.timeout_stop()
 
 
+def hook_prepare_reboot():
+    global sshcmd
+    VirtSubproc.check_exec(sshcmd + ['--', 'sync'])
+
+
 def hook_wait_reboot():
     global sshcmd
